description: This file contains unit tests for the SlotterUtil class in an Android notes application. It tests the method fillListByInitials, verifying it correctly groups notes into sections based on initials and handles empty titles.

classes.name: SlotterUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the SlotterUtil's fillListByInitials method.

methods.name: fillListByInitials_shouldAddSectionItems
methods.description: Tests that the fillListByInitials method correctly adds section items when there are multiple notes with different initials.

methods.name: fillListByInitials_shouldAcceptEmptyTitles
methods.description: Tests that the fillListByInitials method handles notes with empty titles appropriately.
